occlusion:morning-flow/Pedaling down dog: The far thigh sits behind the near thigh while that leg is the straight one. The pedal reads from the near leg and the two shins.
thumbnail:daily-13/Deep squats: Standing at 28 pt, the far arm lies along the thicker trunk and thigh. One limb fewer for the standing instant only.
thumbnail:daily-13/Plank hold: Same cause: the far leg is behind the near leg, so at 28 pt the plank reads as one line of body on two forearms, which is what a plank is.
